entities.summary: Alan Manning Chambers is the former president of Exodus International and co-founder of Speak. Love., formerly headquartered in Orlando, Florida. Before coming to Exodus, Chambers served on the pastoral team at Calvary Assembly of God, one of the largest churches in Orlando.
